value.summary: This change refactors the host loop to support concurrent rounds: a single `HiveStep::Speak` now carries a vector of turns and a shared next_state, and the loop appends every turn (including failure-system rows) before committing any state.  The diff looks sound — the concurrent-round invariants documented in the looked‑up types are respected, the exclusive bound passed to `read_pinboard` matches the round_start, and the commit is moved to after all turns are durable.  No new security problems are introduced.
